bias.en: Bearish · rebound capped by the 100-day average
bias.zh: 偏空 · 反弹受制于 100 日均线

read.en: Marvell rose 4.1% on Oct 19 to $237.09, trading between $234.82 and $246.58. It is below its falling 5-day ($244.0) and 10-day ($260.8) averages, the rising 30-day ($252.6) and the rising 100-day ($241.2), and above the 200-day ($176.6). MACD has been below its signal since Oct 12 and is above zero with a widening histogram, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 8 ($277.89), and RSI is 42.7.
read.zh: Marvell 10月19日上涨 4.1%，收于 $237.09，盘中区间 $234.82–246.58。股价位于下行的 5 日（$244.0）和 10 日均线（$260.8）、上行的 30 日（$252.6）和上行的 100 日均线（$241.2）下方，位于 200 日均线（$176.6）上方。MACD 自 10月12日起位于信号线下方，仍在零轴之上，柱状图扩大，抛物线 SAR 自 10月8日起看空（$277.89），RSI 为 42.7。

read.en: The $226.5–227.3 lows held and the bounce briefly pushed above the 100-day average, but the close fell back below it. Resistance is $241.2 (100-day), then $244–246.6 (5-day average, Oct 19 high) and $252.6 (30-day). Support is $234.8 (Oct 19 low), then $226.5–227.3 (Oct 15 and 16 lows) and $200.6 (Sep 1 low). A close above $241.2 would open $246.6–252.6.
